_comment: Top-left corner regression (research/14 §6.10): on macOS with the Hidden frame, the corner above the ribbon and under the window buttons (.workspace-ribbon.mod-primary::before, 44 x 40 pt) must show the same colour as the left dock's tab strip next to it (both the note list: --titlebar-background opaque, the note-list acrylic while translucent). Regions are background-only rectangles in window points of tests/visual/capture-obsidian.sh captures: corner-low is between the window buttons and the corner's bottom border, tabstrip-low the same rows of the tab strip between its icons and the sidebar toggle. No Inkdrop reference: the check is continuity within one capture, any theme, opaque or translucent.
